MetaData.Label: Sparnatural Service dbb4564-dirty
MetaData.Description:
Serves the Sparnatural visual query builder, configured automatically from the data of a graph and the CMEM shapes catalog. It runs in the browser with the permissions of the logged-in user.
Open the [query builder](/dataintegration/workspace/projects/sparnatural-service/browse/sparnatural.html), or switch to the application view *Search*.
